# Retail POS 3.0.0-RC5

Retail POS 3.0.0-RC5 brings a broad set of improvements to daily sales, catalogue and stock management, administration, and reporting.

## Highlights

- Sales workflows now handle tax-inclusive product prices more clearly, with improved ticket entry, payment validation, refunds, and sale corrections.
- Product and category management have clearer, more adaptable screens, and catalogue search supports multiple terms.
- Stock receiving, stock history, and product-first catalogue workflows are easier to navigate.
- Administration and reporting now provide clearer welcome screens and more readable reports.
- Reliability, database migration checks, and automated coverage for sales, refunds, stock movements, and tax calculations have been strengthened.
- Unused legacy integrations and dependencies have been removed, including JavaPOS and BeanShell support.

## Distribution

This release candidate is distributed as portable x86_64 packages for Linux, Windows, and Intel macOS. Windows and macOS packages include a bundled Java runtime; the Linux package uses the system Java installation. Every package includes a SHA256 checksum.

Native installers, Apple Silicon support, Linux ARM64 support, and platform signing remain planned follow-up work.
